title: Pattern Matching with Option
explanation_md: The `Option` type represents an optional value. Pattern matching is the idiomatic way to handle `Some` and `None` cases.

title: Struct with Implementation
description: Defining a data structure and its associated methods.
explanation_md: Structs are used to create custom types. Methods are defined within an `impl` block.

title: Error Handling with Result
description: Using Result for functions that can fail.
explanation_md: The `?` operator is a shorthand for returning errors early if a operation fails.

title: Smart Pointer: Box
explanation_md: `Box<T>` is a smart pointer that allows you to store data on the heap rather than the stack.

title: Iterating with Closures
description: Using functional programming patterns in Rust.
explanation_md: Iterators allow you to perform operations on sequences of items. `map` and `collect` are common iterator methods.
